item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera learns in her school in Jaipur that Earth supports life, while planets much closer to or much farther from the Sun generally do not. Which statement best explains why Earth's position around the Sun allows life to exist?

options.A: Earth's distance from the Sun keeps temperatures in a range where water can stay liquid, making life possible.
options.B: Earth is called the Blue Planet, so any planet with that label becomes habitable.
options.C: Earth's nearness to other planets in space allows water to flow onto its surface.
options.D: Earth's orbital distance is produced by the presence of liquid water on its surface.
